title: RL Financial Infrastructure 4.0
summary: A modular reinforcement-learning platform for algorithmic trading, supporting single-asset, multi-stock, and multi-agent PPO-based strategies with a custom Gym-compliant trading environment; its synthetic data augmentation is implemented via a custom TimeGAN rather than the SDV library itself, though sdv and sdmetrics are listed as dependencies with no observed usage in the code.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==0.16.0; sdmetrics==0.8.1; no matching code usage found
needs: Dependencies listed but no pattern hits in code; unclear whether sdv/sdmetrics are actually invoked or just listed alongside the custom TimeGAN module.
